meta.description: Crave Bakery — Laravel 13 + Inertia Vue bakery e-commerce architecture map

techStack.frontend: Vite 8 + Tailwind CSS + Headless UI + Tabler Icons

workspaces.name: pastaci-website
workspaces.description: Monolith: Laravel HTTP + Inertia SSR bridge + Vue pages

workspaces.name: resources/js
workspaces.description: Inertia Vue 3 pages, components, layouts, composables

infrastructure.name: Stripe (Cashier)
infrastructure.description: Payment processing via Laravel Cashier / StripePaymentService.

dockerDiagram.description: No docker-compose.yml in this project. Local/dev uses php artisan serve + Vite.

systemArchitectureDiagram.description: Crave Bakery layered architecture: browser → Laravel/Inertia → services → MySQL/Stripe.

swaggerSchemas.matchStatus: Inertia Web App — documented 119 routes (no OpenAPI server)
swaggerSchemas.servedAt: n/a (Inertia pages, not a public REST API)
swaggerSchemas.securityScheme: session cookie (web) + CSRF; admin / super-admin middleware

schemas.name: Product
schemas.description: Bakery product with pricing, stock, media, categories

schemas.name: Order
schemas.description: Customer order with items, payment and delivery status

schemas.name: AdminUser
schemas.description: Admin account with JSON permissions matrix

modules.name: Checkout & Orders
modules.description: Authenticated checkout, order placement, and order history.

modules.name: Customer Payments
modules.description: Stripe payment intent creation and confirmation.

modules.name: Customer Profile & Account
modules.description: Profile, addresses, favourites, collections, and reviews.

modules.name: Authentication

modules.name: Admin Invitations (Public Accept)
modules.description: Guest acceptance of admin invitation tokens.

modules.name: Admin Dashboard
modules.description: Admin home dashboard and admin profile.

modules.name: Admin Promo Codes
modules.description: Admin promo code CRUD, active toggle, and usage tracking.

modules.name: Admin Site Settings & Payments
modules.description: Site settings and payment gateway configuration (super_admin scopes).

modules.name: Admin Users (Super Admin)
modules.description: Invite/manage admin users and permissions matrix.

security.name: AdminMiddleware
security.description: Ensures authenticated user is admin or super_admin.

middleware.name: HandleInertiaRequests
middleware.description: Shares auth, cart count, flash, and site settings with Vue.

services.name: PromoCodeService
services.description: Promo validation at checkout + admin stats/CRUD/toggle

requestPipeline.step: HTTP request hits public/index.php (PHP built-in / Apache / Nginx)
web middleware group runs (session, cookies, CSRF)
requestPipeline.detail: CSRF excepted for stripe/* webhook paths.
Makes $page.props available to all Vue pages.

requestPipeline.step: Route matched from web.php / auth.php / admin.php
requestPipeline.detail: admin.php loaded via withRouting(then:). Named routes via Ziggy on frontend.

requestPipeline.step: auth / admin / super-admin middleware gates access
requestPipeline.detail: AdminMiddleware checks role; SuperAdminMiddleware restricts user management.

requestPipeline.step: FormRequest validates input; Policy authorizes action
Controller delegates to Service; Eloquent persists
requestPipeline.detail: Thin controllers — business logic lives in app/Services.
Vue page receives API Resources — never raw Eloquent models.

errorPipeline: Unhandled exception → Laravel exception handler (JSON when request is api/*)
dataFlow.tenantIsolation: Customer data scoped by auth user_id; admin data gated by role + JSON permissions matrix. Custom route bindings: customer, adminUser.

permissions.description: RBAC from config/permissions.php. super_admin bypasses checks. site_settings and admin_users are super_admin_only scopes.

sqlQueries.label: Public product listing with filters
sqlQueries.purpose: Paginated active products for /products with category/price/stock filters.
sqlQueries.sql: SELECT products.* FROM products WHERE status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL /* + dynamic filters */

sqlQueries.label: Admin category tree
sqlQueries.purpose: Build nested category tree for admin Index view with optional search/status.
sqlQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, name

sqlQueries.label: Resolve guest or user cart
sqlQueries.purpose: Load cart by user_id or session_id and compute count for Inertia shared props.
sqlQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM carts WHERE user_id = ? OR session_id = ? LIMIT 1

sqlQueries.label: Create order from cart
sqlQueries.purpose: Transactional checkout: snapshot line items, totals, delivery, payment status.
sqlQueries.sql: INSERT INTO orders (...) VALUES (...); INSERT INTO order_items (...); /* inside DB::transaction */

sqlQueries.label: Load admin permissions matrix
sqlQueries.purpose: Read/update users.permissions JSON for admin role accounts.
sqlQueries.sql: SELECT id, name, email, role, permissions FROM users WHERE role IN ('admin','super_admin')

_meta.note: Upstream arch-wiki scanner mis-detects FastAPI on Laravel; this manifest is Laravel-adapted. Re-run _build_manifest.py after major route changes, then python build_html.py.
